# Torment

Realistic injury and medical mechanics for survival servers. Adds dynamic injuries, crafted medicine, and surgery to combat and survival.

## Injuries

Players can suffer from bleeding, broken bones, concussions, venom, burns, and infections — all based on damage source.

## Medical System

- 9+ custom medical items: bandages, splints, antibiotics, surgical kits and more
- Recipes use vanilla materials and craftable Medicinal Herbs
- Apply items to yourself or others with sneak + right-click, with progress bars
- Severe injuries require a Surgical Kit and an Operation Table (iron blocks) to treat

## Other Features

- Optional player opt-in system
- Injuries persist across sessions via SQLite
- Fully configurable: chances, thresholds, durations, effects

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/tm` | View your active injuries |
| `/tm toggle` | Opt in or out of the injury system |
| `/tm reload` | Reload config (`torment.admin`) |
| `/tm heal <player> [injury]` | Heal a player (`torment.admin`) |
| `/tm injure <player> <injury>` | Apply an injury manually (`torment.admin`) |
| `/tm give <player> <item> [amount]` | Give medical items (`torment.admin`) |

## Permissions

`torment.admin` — access to all admin commands
